unbalance_kgm.note: residual unbalance per rotor U = m_rot G / Omega_hover

imu_acc_1p_ms2.note: IMU acceleration amplitude, largest axis, 1P unbalance, sustained band, worst of 12 stiffness corners (E70-G3-tape0.0, 118.9 Hz, resonance dwell)

imu_acc_1p_full_ms2.note: same over every rpm to full throttle (transient), worst of 12 stiffness corners (E100-G5-tape0.5, 155.2 Hz, resonance dwell)

imu_rate_1p_dps.note: IMU angular-rate amplitude, 1P, sustained band (removed by the harmonic notch), worst of 12 stiffness corners (E70-G3-tape0.0, 118.9 Hz, resonance dwell)

spar_sigma_1p_pa.note: largest spar bending-stress amplitude on the span, 1P, sustained band, spar alone, worst of 12 stiffness corners (E100-G5-tape1.0, 81.7 Hz, resonance dwell)

spar_sigma_1p_full_pa.note: same over every rpm, worst of 12 stiffness corners (E100-G3-tape0.5, 145.9 Hz, resonance dwell)

imu_acc_2p_per_n.note: IMU acceleration amplitude per newton of 2P load on each rotor (thrust axis + sideways), sustained band, worst of 12 stiffness corners (E100-G5-tape0.0, 153.1 Hz, resonance dwell)

imu_acc_2p_full_per_n.note: same over every rpm, worst of 12 stiffness corners (E70-G5-tape0.0, 133.9 Hz, resonance dwell)

spar_sigma_2p_per_n.note: spar stress amplitude per newton of 2P load, sustained band, worst of 12 stiffness corners (E100-G5-tape1.0, 157.5 Hz, resonance dwell)

t_hover_n.note: hover thrust per rotor, C1 MC-P mass x g / 4
